entities.name: Siege of Penregon
entities.description: First significant event of the Dark Age, a Church of Tal assault on Penregon.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: City that withstood the siege and later fell to glaciers.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Faction that believed all machines were demons and attacked Penregon.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Chief artificer who armed Penregon's civils.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Next target of the Talite army.

events.summary: The Church of Tal masses outside Penregon, led by Raddic and Arah, and infiltrates the city with agents.
events.quote: The Church of Tal massed outside Penregon 's gates

events.summary: Kayla bin-Kroog has Tawnos arm his mechanized civils, which stamp down on insurgents and repel the attack.
The Talite army abandons the siege and moves on to Urza's Tower.
events.quote: abandoned the siege and moved on to attack Urza's Tower

relations.quote: bid her chief artificer Tawnos arm his mechanized civils
